limitations: Twenty distinct states per split, five cases at each middle slot, all current positions different from destinations. Legal skill sequences preserve the completed first layer. Different fixed seeds generate validation; all old reference states excluded except one labelled development regression. Target and extraction intention are supplied offline, not selected by this test.
